extracted.name: Speedy papa al pomodoro
extracted.description: Make our papa al pomodoro, a thrifty Tuscan stew made simply from stale bread and tomatoes. It’s really quick to make and perfect for using up stale bread
ingredient_lines: 3 tbsp olive oil plus extra to drizzle
small bunch basil leaves shredded, stalks finely chopped
150g crusty stale bread (sourdough works well), torn
grated parmesan or vegetarian alternative, to serve
instruction_lines: Heat the oil in a non-stick casserole dish or saucepan. Add the garlic cloves and basil stalks and fry for 1 min. Tip in the chopped tomatoes, a canful of water and the sugar and season to taste. Bring to a simmer and cook for 15 mins.
Stir the bread through the soup to create a thick, stew-like consistency, then stir in most of the basil leaves. Ladle into bowls, finish with parmesan and some extra basil.
